body:
Do we need this condition?
`energy_full` could be `0.0` in the case of a depleted battery that is charging. I think we should still show the charging status in that case.
I think a more fitting title might be `BatteryInfo`.
I can see this possibly returning a long decimal value. Perhaps we should limit the number of decimal places.
I think a more descriptive function name would be `merge_battery_states`.

We need to consider the case in which either the battery manager or the subsequent filter_map does not return any battery information. In those cases, the fold operation will return a `BatteryContructor` with both `energy` and `energy_full` at 0.0.
This will end up in a division by zero on line 109, but apart for that, we should return None in those situations.
I agree with you that this is not a very good condition, but I think that we need something like that.
Sorry, I do not understand, do you want to cast it to an integer value?
Good name, I will update it.

My mistake. I thought that `energy_full` was `energy`.
Yeah, this is a fine condition to have. 👍

My bad. I had forgotten that we round the value later on in the file:
https://github.com/starship/starship/blob/master/src/modules/battery.rs#L61

Nevermind. 😊
